## About
ProAm Auto Accessories grew out of the owner's passion for performance cars and club racing. The goal was to bring world class products for sports cars, European sedans and American muscle cars to Houston area enthusiasts, and ProAm became known as the place to find exclusive and hard to find parts. We were one of the very first distributors in the USA for brands such as Recaro, PIAA, Koni, Redline, Momo, Corbeau and Simpson.
We're on Richmond Avenue, known locally as the Richmond strip, in the Galleria Area. Our facility has a warehouse, a showroom and installation bays, so we don't just sell parts. We install them, set them up and do service and repair work for our local customers.
You're dealing with a small group of professionals who want to help with your car. Customers rate us 4.8 from 66 Google reviews. And yes, it's a good place to hang out with fellow enthusiasts.

## Services
- Oil changes: Full synthetic oils only, using Royal Purple, Red Line Oils or Amsoil products.
- Brake service: Pads, rotors, lines and fluids.
- Suspension replacement: Shocks, struts, springs and bushings.
- Wheel and Tire Packages: Mounting and balancing for road tires and off-road tires.
- Classic and Muscle Car Service: Service work for classic and muscle cars.
- Corner Weight Balancing: Done on digital scales, with or without turnplates.
- Coil OverSuspension and Big Brake kit installation and set-up: Installation and set-up of coilover suspension and big brake kits.
- Complete Detailing Services: Clay-bar paint rejuvenation, leather cleaning and treatment, and wheel detailing.

## FAQ
Q: Do you price match?
A: If you find a lower delivered price from a competitor on the identical product, we'll try to match it. Auction sites, rebates, liquidations and membership club stores don't count.

Q: Will you install the parts I buy from you?
A: Yes. We install the performance, appearance and truck accessories we sell, and we do all kinds of service work and repair.

Q: I bought tires from Tirerack.com. Can you install them?
A: Yes. We're a Preferred Installer for Tirerack.com purchasers.
